plugins.name: ChromaGold 200
plugins.summary: Kodak Gold 200 colour negative film, printed: a physical model of the C-41 negative and its print from Kodak's data sheet, with golden yellows and oranges, deep carmine reds, olive greens, dense warm…
plugins.description: Kodak Gold 200 colour negative film, printed: a physical model of the C-41 negative and its print from Kodak's data sheet, with golden yellows and oranges, deep carmine reds, olive greens, dense warm shadows and highlights that hold, and the film's soft grain, halation and softness. Exposure shifts the negative as a real under- or over-exposure would. Meant for the Display stage.
plugins.author: nwh212

plugins.name: ChromaLome Purple
plugins.summary: LomoChrome Purple: greens turn purple, blues go teal, yellows pink, reds stay red
plugins.description: LomoChrome Purple: greens turn purple, blues go teal, yellows pink, reds stay red. A C-41 film model whose layers see swapped light, fitted to a ColorChecker shot on the real film, with smooth colour all the way through (no hard edges between colours). ISO is the speed you rated it at: 400 well exposed (clean whites, deep violet, teal), 100 two stops over (faded, pastel, cream-green highlights). Warmth leans the scan toward cream highlights. Meant for the Display stage.
plugins.author: nwh212

plugins.name: ChromaStill 800T
plugins.summary: CineStill 800T: Kodak VISION3 500T cinema film with its rem-jet removed, as a physical model of the negative and its print from Kodak's data sheet, with the film's famous red halation around lights a…
plugins.description: CineStill 800T: Kodak VISION3 500T cinema film with its rem-jet removed, as a physical model of the negative and its print from Kodak's data sheet, with the film's famous red halation around lights and bright edges, soft grain and softness. Hue sets how far the picture leans green-blue, as 800T usually does; Exposure shifts the negative as a real under- or over-exposure would. Meant for the Display stage.
plugins.author: nwh212
